title: [Master] - Slice 641375: [Sustainability] Collect Amount from G/L Entries: track collected entries to prevent double counting
summary: Sustainability Journal's collect amount function now tracks which G/L entries have been collected to prevent double-counting emissions when running collection over overlapping or adjacent periods.
key_points: New relation table links collected G/L entries to their corresponding sustainability entries
Collect function excludes previously collected entries based on the relation table
Indexed collected marker maintains fast exclusion filtering on large ledgers
Reversing sustainability entries removes their links, making entries collectable again
Follows the existing G/L to Item Ledger Relation model
